public_rationale: The sentence reports Marcus's own difficulty in finding examples ('I am hard-pressed to find'). It does not say what counts as 'truly' autonomous, and it does not define 'domain'. Anthropic's Project Vend report (27 June 2025) said Claude 'made too many mistakes to run the shop successfully.' That fits a strict reading, but it covers one experiment on one task. Klarna's press release (27 February 2024) said its AI assistant 'proficiently handles a wide array of queries', including refunds, returns and disputes. This is the company's own statement. The same release said customers could still choose live agents. It does not say whether any chats were completed with no human step. It also comes before the summer 2025 period the record covers. Whether the claim holds depends on a threshold Marcus did not give, and the sentence is hedged. So it cannot fairly be scored.
limitations: No independent audit shows how many LLM-handled tasks in mid-2025 involved no human step at all.
The Klarna statement is an unverified company claim from February 2024, not from summer 2025. It does not show that chats were handled with no human involvement.
Project Vend is a single experiment and does not test other domains.
Vendor resolution-rate claims and reports of Klarna rehiring human staff were not checked.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Marcus is hard-pressed to find any domain in which LLMs truly act autonomously without human intervention.

statement.excerpt: I am hard-pressed to find any domain in which LLMs truly act autonomously without human intervention.

our_interpretation: The sentence reports the speaker's own difficulty in finding examples ('I am hard-pressed'), which is a hedge, not a firm claim of fact.

'Truly act autonomously without human intervention' has no stated threshold. On a strict reading, no deployed system (even a calculator) runs with no human setup or oversight. On a loose reading, customer-service bots that resolve chats alone already qualify. No ordinary middle reading settles the matter.
For reference only, the period described is summer 2025.
criteria.support_condition: Not scorable. Under a strict reading, evidence that LLM deployments in summer 2025 all relied on human oversight, escalation or correction would fit.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Not scorable. Under a loose reading, evidence of LLMs completing tasks end-to-end with no human step, such as customer-service bots resolving most chats on their own, would cut against it.
